text: Two anomalies were observed on individual slides that suggest some images in this deck may have been copied in from a different, unrelated source document rather than authored fresh for this presentation: (1) the slide showing the 'ARROZA Rice Bran Oil' product (this deck's page 11) has a corrupted/garbled title rendered as unreadable characters (approximately 'eRbgqaplitBlk...ksuT§'), so the presenter's original Khmer heading for that slide could not be transcribed with confidence — only the legible product label content (rice bran oil claims) could be extracted reliably. That same slide also shows a stray page number '8' printed in its bottom-right corner, which does not match its actual position (11th page) in this deck. (2) A plain rice-field photo slide (this deck's page 18) similarly shows a stray page number '76' in its corner, again inconsistent with this deck's own pagination. These stray numbers most likely carried over from the page numbering of whatever original source document/report these particular images were copied from, rather than reflecting an error in this extraction. No rice-bran-oil product information was lost as a result — it has been captured in a separate chunk — but readers should be aware the exact original slide title for that page is unrecoverable from this copy.
